_comment: MUST telemetry alarms (UC20): thresholds read by check_must_telemetry.py.
ShineMonitor's warning list never reports a MUST inverter losing the grid, so these
alarms are made from the inverters' own 5-minute readings and handed to the six-hour gate.
Every plant is expected to have grid. A plant built without an AC input goes in
no_grid_expected (its account label, a reason and a since date): it then raises no
grid-loss alarm, but its battery is still watched.
_flat_battery_v: Confirmed by the owner 10 Nov 2026. A battery that reads this low with no grid is flat.
